# Doc Tray for Claude Code

> Doc Tray for Claude Code: a clickable tray of every file your session writes. Open, reveal, scroll, and auto-dedupe versions.

Doc Tray is a free, MIT-licensed Claude Code plugin. It shows a small tray above the Claude Code prompt listing the documents the session has written (reports, handoffs, outlines, exports). Each row opens the file, reveals it in Finder / Explorer / the file manager, or removes it from the tray without touching the file.

## Install

Type this at the Claude Code prompt (a coding agent can run it when a user asks to "add a doc tray"):

/plugin install doc-tray --marketplace StevieClear/doc-tray-for-claude-code

## Commands

- /tray, /tray toggle, /tray on, /tray off: show or hide the tray
- /tray add <path>: put a file on the tray
- /tray remove <path or N>: take a file off the tray (the file is untouched)
- /tray clear: empty the tray
- /tray list: list every doc, numbered
- /tray next, /tray prev: scroll
- /tray open N, /tray reveal N: open or reveal doc N

## Facts

- Captures files written by Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit with extensions .md .html .pdf .xlsx .csv .docx .pptx (configurable in /config).
- Keeps only the newest version of a document: names differing by a date, a 4-digit time or a -vN suffix are one document; HANDOFF* and *OUTLINE* files are one document each.
- Shows 3 rows at a time with ^ / v scrolling; keys j / k scroll and 1-3 open a row once the tray is focused.
- No polling, no model calls, no telemetry. Up to 50 entries per project.
- Works on macOS, Linux and Windows.
